Testing in practice

How I tested this site →

Step 1

I went through the requirements with the client and asked what mattered most. Accessibility was their top priority. One of the tests I prepared looked at how someone using only a keyboard could navigate the main menu.

Step 2

Before the first version was ready, I wrote down what the menu had to do to pass. I needed to move forwards and backwards between links, see which link had focus and open the right page with Enter.

Step 3

As I tabbed through the main menu, the focus indicator disappeared on some links. I could no longer tell which link I was about to open. I reported the bug to the developer, who fixed it.

Step 4

After the fix, I went through the menu again with the keyboard. This time I could see which item had focus. The retest passed.
